span.p:
The trap. Without it you get metadata and no PDFs.
Every entry then reports no PDF attachment — not an error,
just an empty corpus. Same if you rename the companion folder:
bib_reader resolves file fields relative to the .bib.
docs/ZOTERO.md

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.small:
every key is optional — but the file must exist,
or chitragupta.config refuses to import

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.small:
all = OS packages (pdftotext, TeX Live, Pandoc) + Python.
No stage argument = Python only.

p.small: needs the venv — this is the one command that does

span.p:
1 — something didn't parse.
The summary names each one.
Fix or remove it; re-running is cheap.

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 — another run holds the lock.
Nothing was lost. Try again later.

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.small:
read-only, takes no lock, needs no venv —
safe to run while a sync is going

span.p:
Nothing is citable yet.
Almost always the Export Files trap above.
--status no_pdf tells you which entries and why.

p.i: “write a survey section on digital twin composability”
p.small:
in Claude Code. The matching skill in .claude/skills/
picks it up and runs its own gate → references → render chain,
looping on the gate until it exits 0 before showing you anything.
